basic_info.description: Elegant Victorian condominium in prime Pacific Heights, renovated with seismic, electrical, and heating upgrades! Replete with original period detail, this full-floor flat balances enduring classic architecture with relaxed modern living. Designed for easy entertaining, the front features rich hardwood floors, oversized south-facing bay windows, sun drenched formal living and dining rooms, and a wood burning fireplace. In the back the open lay-out family suite includes a gorgeous kitchen with custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, walk-in pantry, and deluxe appliances, which opens to the huge, airy family room and a sunny breakfast area - all overlooking the lovely, landscaped common garden. Connected by 5 generous bedrooms and 2 pristine baths, the flexible floorplan provides a fantastic house-like alternative, with space for multiple home offices, children's playrooms/den, en-suite primary bathroom expansion potential, and guest bedrooms. This boutique 3-unit building offers 2-car garage parking and additional storage- a true luxury in the city. Knob and tube removed! Incredible location, square footage, light and opportunity half a block to the shops and dining on Fillmore St., and walkable to public transportation, many of SF's finest schools, and beloved parks.
